advanced-filter-description: Filtè Avanse pèmèt ou ekri yon chèn ki gen operatè sa yo: == != <= >= && || ( ) Yo itilize yon espas pou separe Operatè yo. Pou inyore yon karaktè kontwòl izole, itilize yon antislach. Pa egzanp: Field1 == I\'m. Ou ka konbine plizyè kondisyon tou. Pa egzanp: F1 == V1 || F1 == V2. Nòmalman, tout operatè yo entèprete soti agoch pou rive adwat. Ou ka chanje lòd la avèk parantèz. Pa egzanp: F1 == V1 && ( F2 == V2 || F2 == V3 ). Ou kapab chèche nan chan tèks yo avèk regex tou: F1 == /Tes.*/i

import-board-instruction-leo: Kole yon plan Leo (fichye .leo). Eleman nan premye nivo a vin lis, eleman ki anba yo vin kat ki gen tèks eleman an kòm deskripsyon, epi eleman ki pi ba yo vin lis verifikasyon. Eleman ki make yo enpòte kòm fini.
import-board-instruction-opml: Paste an OPML outline, as Workflowy, Dynalist, OmniOutliner, Logseq and other outliners export it. Top-level items become lists, their children become cards with the note as the description, and deeper items become checklists. Completed items import as done.
import-board-instruction-orgmode: Paste an Org mode file, as Emacs, Orgzly or Beorg write it. Top-level headings become lists and second-level headings become cards. TODO and DONE, priorities, tags, SCHEDULED, DEADLINE and CLOSED are kept, and checkboxes and deeper headings become checklists.
import-board-instruction-todotxt: Kole yon fichye todo.txt: yon travay sou chak liy, jan aplikasyon todo.txt ak aplikasyon konpatib yo ekri li. Travay ki fini yo ("x") ale nan Done, +project ak @context vin etikèt, (A) vin yon etikèt priyorite, epi due: ak t: vin dat limit ak dat kòmansman.
import-board-instruction-taskwarrior: Kole rezilta task export la: yon tablo JSON oswa yon travay sou chak liy. Travay ki fini yo ale nan Done, project ak priority vin etikèt, annotations vin kòmantè, epi depends vin depandans sou travay k ap bloke yo.
import-board-instruction-focalboard: Dezip fichye .boardarchive la epi kole kontni board.jsonl tablo a, avèk oswa san liy vèsyon an. Pwopriyete ki sèvi pou gwoupe nan vi tablo a vin lis, lòt pwopriyete seleksyon yo vin etikèt, blòk tèks ak kaz pou tcheke yo vin deskripsyon an ak yon lis verifikasyon, epi kòmantè yo konsève. Imaj ak fichye atache yo pa enpòte.
import-board-instruction-todoist: In Todoist, open the project menu and choose Export as a template, then paste the CSV file. Sections become lists, tasks become cards, sub-tasks become a checklist, notes become comments, and @labels and priorities p1 to p3 become labels.
import-board-instruction-planner: In Microsoft Planner, open the plan's menu and choose Export plan to Excel, then choose that .xlsx file. Buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their assignees, dates, labels, checklist and description; Progress, Priority and Completed By become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-meistertask: In MeisterTask, click the project name, choose Export project and export the CSV, then paste it. Sections become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, due date, assignee and tags; completed tasks keep their completion date. A CSV written for MeisterTask's own import works too.
import-board-instruction-obsidian: In Obsidian, open the Kanban board's file as Markdown (or open the .md file in a text editor), then paste all of it. Lanes become lists with their card limits, cards keep their tags, dates, priority, fields and checklist, and the Archive becomes archived cards.
import-board-instruction-linear: In Linear, export the issues as CSV (Settings, Import / Export, Export data, or a view's export), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, teams become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their assignee, labels, dates, parent issue, priority, estimate, project and cycle.
import-board-instruction-ticktick: In TickTick, open Settings, Account, Backup & Import and generate a backup, then paste the CSV file. Each TickTick list becomes a swimlane and its columns become lists; tasks keep their tags, dates, checklist, priority and subtasks.
import-board-instruction-clickup: In ClickUp, export the tasks as CSV (Settings, Imports / Exports, Export Items, or a List or Table view's export with all columns), then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists, ClickUp lists become swimlanes, and tasks become cards with their subtasks, assignees, tags, dates, priority and time.
import-board-instruction-nullboard: In Nullboard, open the board, choose Export this board... from the menu, open the .nbx file in a text editor and paste its contents. Lists become lists and notes become cards: a note's first line is the card title and the rest its description. A raw note gets the label raw. A file with several boards imports its first board.
import-board-instruction-kanri: In Kanri, open Import & Export and choose Export individual board (or Export all data), then paste the .json file. Columns become lists and cards become cards, with their description, due date, tags and colors; a card's tasks become a checklist. From an all-data export the first board is imported.
import-board-instruction-pivotal: In Pivotal Tracker, open the project's MORE tab and choose Export CSV (or select stories and choose Bulk Actions, CSV), then paste the CSV. Each story state becomes a list and stories become cards, with their type and labels, owners, requester, dates, comments, tasks and blockers; Estimate becomes Story points and iterations become sprints.
import-board-instruction-tasksorg: In Tasks.org, open Settings, Backups and choose Export tasks, then paste the contents of that .json file. Lists become lists and tasks become cards, with their notes, tags, dates, comments and subtasks; completed tasks keep their completion date, and priority becomes a custom field.
import-board-instruction-monday: In monday.com, open the board menu, choose More actions and Export board to Excel (with updates and subitems if you like), then choose that .xlsx file. The Status column becomes lists and groups become swimlanes; people, dates, timeline and tags keep their places, other columns become custom fields and updates become comments.
import-board-instruction-superproductivi: In Super Productivity, open Settings, then Sync & Backup, choose Export Data and paste the contents of the sp-backup .json file. Each project becomes a swimlane and tasks become cards in To Do, In Progress, Backlog or Done, with their notes, tags, due date, time spent and sub-tasks; archived tasks become archived cards.
import-board-instruction-taiga: In Taiga, open Admin > Project > Export and download the project dump (unpack a .json.gz file first), then paste its JSON. User story statuses become lists, user stories become cards with their tasks as subtasks, epics and issues get swimlanes of their own, and sprints, tags, comments and custom attributes come along. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-vikunja: In Vikunja, open Settings, choose Data Export and download the .zip file it sends you, then choose that file, or paste the data.json inside it. Kanban buckets become lists and tasks become cards, with their labels, assignees, dates, description, task lists as checklists and comments; priority, percent done and done become custom fields. Attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-quire: In Quire, open the project menu and choose Export CSV, then paste the CSV. Statuses become lists and tasks become cards, with their subtasks as child cards, assignees, tags as labels, start, due and completed dates, description and priority as a custom field. Comments and attachments are not in Quire's CSV.
import-board-instruction-wrike: In Wrike, export a project or folder to Excel, or fill in Wrike's Excel import template, then choose that .xlsx file. Folder and project rows become swimlanes, Status becomes lists and tasks become cards, with their Key, parent task, assignees, start and end dates, dependencies and description; Priority, Duration and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-teamwork: In Teamwork.com, fill in the Excel task import template (Tasklist, Task, Description, Assign to, Start date, Due date, Priority, Estimated time, Tags, Status) and save it as .xlsx, then choose that file. Task lists become lists and tasks become cards; a task starting with -, # or > becomes a subtask of the task above it (--, ## or >> one level deeper). Assignees, dates and tags keep their places; Priority, Estimated time and Complete become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-businessmap: In Businessmap (formerly Kanbanize), open Advanced Search, choose Configure results to pick the columns, download the Excel file, then choose that .xlsx file. Columns are read by their English names (Title, Column, Lane, Owner, Deadline ...): if your account uses another language, rename the header row to English first. Column becomes lists and Lane swimlanes; owners, tags, color, dates, comments and parent links keep their places, and Priority, Size, Type and other columns become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-redmine: In Redmine, open the project's Issues, choose Also available in: CSV at the bottom of the list, pick the columns (All columns, with Description) and export, then paste the CSV. Redmine names the columns in your language, so set your language to English in My account before exporting. Each status becomes a list and issues become cards, with the tracker as a label, assignee, author, dates, parent task and related issues; priority, category, target version, estimated time, % Done and custom fields become custom fields.
import-board-instruction-notion: In Notion, open the database as a full page, choose ••• and Export, pick Markdown & CSV, and choose the .zip file it downloads, or one database CSV from it, or paste that CSV. A column named Status becomes the lists (without one, the first column that looks like a select does, and the import report says which); rows become cards with their title, tags as labels, people as members, dates, and the page text as the description; other columns become custom fields. Relations, images and attachments are not imported.
import-board-instruction-plane: In Plane, open Workspace Settings, choose Exports, export the projects as JSON, CSV or Excel and download the .zip file, then choose that file, or one file from inside it, or paste the JSON or CSV. States become lists, projects become swimlanes, and issues become cards with their identifier, parent, assignees, labels, dates, links and comments; priority, estimate, cycle and module become custom fields. Plane's export has no descriptions or attachments, so they are not imported.

r-wrike-workflow-note: A Wrike workflow is a list of statuses, each in the Active, Completed, Deferred or Cancelled group. Export writes this board's lists as one, named after the board, in the JSON Wrike's API returns for workflows: create that workflow in Wrike before importing the board's Wrike Excel export, so its statuses are applied. Import reads that JSON pasted above, from WeKan or from Wrike's GET /workflows, into the chosen board: a status without a list becomes a list, and a rule marks a card complete when it is moved into a Completed or Cancelled status and incomplete in an Active or Deferred one. Wrike's own automation rules cannot be exported from Wrike.

globalSearch-instructions-operator-sort: `__operator_sort__:<sort-name>` - kote *<sort-name>* se youn nan `__predicate_due__`, `__predicate_created__` oswa `__predicate_modified__`. Pou yon triyaj desandan, mete yon `-` devan non triyaj la.

globalSearch-instructions-notes-2:
Operatè ki sanble yo konbine avèk *OR*. Kat ki koresponn ak nenpòt kondisyon ap retounen.
`__operator_list__:Available __operator_list__:Blocked` ta retounen kat ki nan nenpòt lis ki rele *Blocked* oswa *Available*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3: Operatè ki diferan yo konbine avèk *AND*. Se sèlman kat ki koresponn ak tout operatè diferan yo ki retounen. `__operator_list__:Available __operator_label__:red` retounen sèlman kat nan lis *Available* ki gen yon etikèt *red*.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-3-2: Ou ka presize jou kòm yon nonb antye pozitif oswa negatif, oswa itilize `__predicate_week__`, `__predicate_month__`, `__predicate_quarter__` oswa `__predicate_year__` pou peryòd aktyèl la.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-4: Rechèch tèks yo pa fè diferans ant lèt majiskil ak miniskil.
globalSearch-instructions-notes-5: Pa defo, rechèch la pa chèche kat ki achive.

database-migration-description: Migre done ki baze sou tèks (tout bagay sof pyès jwenn ak avatar, ki rete nan sistèm fichye a) ant MongoDB ak FerretDB v1 (SQLite). Lòt bazdone a dwe ap fonksyone epi li dwe aksesib (pò pa defo: FerretDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27018, MongoDB mongodb://127.0.0.1:27019; ranplase avèk WEKAN_FERRETDB_URL / WEKAN_MONGODB_URL). Lè li fini, fè MONGO_URL pwente sou lòt bazdone a epi redemare WeKan (sou Snap: snap set wekan database=ferretdb oswa =mongodb).
database-migrate-to-ferretdb: Migre done tèks nan FerretDB v1 (SQLite)
database-migration-confirm: Kopye tout koleksyon ki baze sou tèks nan __db__? Pyès jwenn ak avatar nan sistèm fichye a pa afekte. Bazdone sib la dwe ap fonksyone.
sandstorm-migration-description: Lè WeKan fonksyone anndan yon grain Sandstorm, ansyen bazdone MongoDB 3 li a migre nan FerretDB v1 (SQLite) nan premye demaraj la, epi pyès jwenn ak avatar yo deplase soti nan bazdone a pou ale nan repètwa files/attachments ak files/avatars grain nan. Sa montre si migrasyon an reyisi ak konbyen espas disk ansyen fichye bazdone MongoDB brit yo toujou itilize anndan grain nan, epi li pèmèt ou efase fichye brit sa yo pou libere espas.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-description: Apre yon migrasyon reyisi, done yo nan FerretDB ak sistèm fichye a, konsa ansyen fichye brit bazdone MongoDB 3 yo ka efase pou libere espas disk grain nan. Sa pa ka defèt.
sandstorm-delete-raw-mongodb-confirm: Efase fichye brit bazdone MongoDB 3 yo pou libere espas disk? Done yo deja migre nan FerretDB ak sistèm fichye a. Sa pa ka defèt.
sandstorm-raw-mongodb-deleted: Fichye brit bazdone MongoDB yo efase, espas libere
features-desc: Fonksyonalite opsyonèl WeKan sa a ofri. Yon fonksyonalite ki pa tcheke kache nan koòdone tout moun. Done li yo konsève epi otorizasyon yo pa chanje.
feature-views-table-desc: Tablo a kòm yon tab kat ou ka klase.
feature-views-calendar-desc: Kalandriye ak kalandriye pou plizyè tablo.
feature-views-overview-desc: Estatistik, gwoupman selon moun ki responsab la, plan wout, panèl kontwòl ak gwo tablo.
feature-views-scrum-desc: Lis travay pwodwi a, sprint yo, rapò sprint ak vitès.
feature-views-flow-charts-desc: Travay ki rete ak travay ki fini, sikilasyon kimilatif, dire sik ak dire livrezon, kantite travay ki fini, laj travay, blokaj, Monte Carlo ak lòt mezi sikilasyon.
feature-views-map-desc: Kat travay kòm makè sou yon imaj ki telechaje.
feature-approval-required: Kenbe fonksyonalite mizajou WeKan ajoute yo dezaktive jiskaske yon administratè aktive yo
feature-preview-admins: Administratè yo wè fonksyonalite dezaktive yo pou yo ka eseye yo an premye
feature-pilot-users: Itilizatè pilòt ki wè fonksyonalite dezaktive yo tou
feature-pilot-users-unknown: Anrejistre. Nou pa jwenn non itilizatè sa yo:
card-field-visibility-desc: Chan ki nan Paramèt tablo / Kat yo ke tablo yo ka montre. Yon chan ki pa tcheke kache sou tout kat, ti kat ak nan Paramèt tablo / Kat sou tout tablo. Done kat yo ak paramèt tablo yo pa chanje. Lè ou tcheke chan an ankò, chak tablo parèt selon paramèt li te genyen anvan. Chak tablo gen pwòp lòd chan li yo.
cards-loading-auto: Otomatik (chajman pwogresif sèlman pou gwo tablo)
cards-loading-description: WeKan chaje kat tablo yo otomatikman: yon gwo tablo (ki depase papòt gwosè a) chaje sèlman kat ki vizib kounye a (defilman san fen) ansanm ak yon kontè an dirèk, konsa li rete rapid epi itilize mwens memwa ak bann pasant, pandan tablo ki pi piti yo chaje tout kat pou eksperyans ki pi senp ak tout fonksyonalite. Pa gen anyen pou konfigire. Operatè yo ka toujou fòse yon mòd avèk varyab anviwònman CARDS_LOADING (all/lazy/auto) ak CARDS_LOADING_LAZY_THRESHOLD.
cards-loading-lazy-note: Chajman pwogresif kat se eksperimantal: kontè kat ak limit WIP yo egzak, men afichaj Kalandriye/Tablo done/Gantt ak seleksyon miltip montre sèlman kat ki chaje jiskaprezan. Rechaje tablo ouvè yo apre ou chanje sa.
render-links-as-plain-text-description: Lè li aktive, tout lyen (ni lyen markdown tankou [label](url), ni baliz HTML brit <a href>) toujou parèt kòm tèks senp ki pa ka klike nan tout chan tèks rich (tit tablo ak kat, deskripsyon, kòmantè, lis verifikasyon, elatriye). Sa anpeche lyen twonpè ki ka klike. Li dezaktive pa defo, konsa lyen yo rete klikab.
always-show-code-as-text: Toujou montre tout kòd kòm tèks senp
always-show-code-as-text-description: Lè li aktive, tèks rich pa janm rann kòm markdown oswa HTML: tout sous la toujou parèt kòm tèks senp nan tout chan tèks rich (tit tablo ak kat, deskripsyon, kòmantè, lis verifikasyon, elatriye). Sa revele kontni kache — kòmantè HTML (<!-- -->), sib lyen markdown yo, JavaScript ak nenpòt lòt kòd — konsa tout kòd toujou vizib, li pa klikab epi li pa egzekite. Li dezaktive pa defo, konsa markdown rann nòmalman.
disable-all-import-description: Lè li aktive, tout fonksyon enpòtasyon etenn: enpòte yon tablo soti nan WeKan JSON, Trello, CSV/Excel, Jira, Kanboard, NextCloud Deck, OpenProject, GitHub, GitLab, Gitea ak Forgejo, ansanm ak klone yon tablo. Opsyon meni enpòtasyon yo kache epi sèvè a rejte tout demann enpòtasyon. Li dezaktive pa defo.
disable-all-export-description: Lè li aktive, tout fonksyon ekspòtasyon etenn: ekspòte yon tablo kòm WeKan JSON, CSV, Excel, Kanboard, oswa nan NextCloud Deck / OpenProject / GitHub / GitLab / Gitea / Forgejo, ak ekspòtasyon yon sèl pyès jwenn. Opsyon meni ekspòtasyon yo kache epi sèvè a rejte tout demann ekspòtasyon. Li dezaktive pa defo.
disable-import-avatars-description: Lè li aktive, avatar (foto pwofil itilizatè) pa janm enpòte. Sa kouvri enpòtasyon WeKan JSON, enpòtasyon Trello ak senkronizasyon avatar soti nan founisè idantite ekstèn pandan koneksyon (LDAP, OIDC/OAuth2). Non ak lòt done toujou enpòte; se sèlman avatar yo ki sote. Li dezaktive pa defo.
disable-export-avatars-description: Lè li aktive, avatar (foto pwofil itilizatè) pa janm enkli lè yon tablo ekspòte (ekspòtasyon WeKan JSON ak CSV). Non itilizatè ak lòt done toujou ekspòte; se sèlman avatar yo ki pa ladan. Li dezaktive pa defo.
anonymize-import-users-description: Lè li aktive, enpòtasyon yon tablo WeKan JSON ranplase non itilizatè, non konplè ak inisyal chak itilizatè enpòte avèk espas rezève konte (itilizatè1, itilizatè2, ...), retire avatar yo epi re-ekri mansyon @non-itilizatè (ak chan mande-pa / asiyen-pa) anndan kontni kat ak kòmantè enpòte. Okenn idantite reyèl itilizatè ki soti nan tablo sous la pa estoke. Mo "itilizatè" a swiv lang moun k ap enpòte a. Li dezaktive pa defo.
anonymize-export-users-description: Lè li aktive, ekspòtasyon yon tablo ranplase non itilizatè, non konplè ak inisyal chak itilizatè ekspòte avèk espas rezève konte (itilizatè1, itilizatè2, ...), retire avatar yo epi re-ekri mansyon @non-itilizatè (ak chan mande-pa / asiyen-pa) anndan kontni kat ak kòmantè. Fichye ekspòte a pa pote okenn idantite reyèl itilizatè. Mo "itilizatè" a swiv lang moun k ap ekspòte a. Li dezaktive pa defo.
anonymize-account-confirm-popup: Lè li aktive, ekspòtasyon yon tablo ranplase non itilizatè, non konplè ak inisyal chak itilizatè ekspòte avèk espas rezève konte (itilizatè1, itilizatè2, ...), retire avatar yo epi re-ekri mansyon @non-itilizatè (ak chan mande-pa / asiyen-pa) anndan kontni kat ak kòmantè. Fichye ekspòte a pa pote okenn idantite reyèl itilizatè. Mo "itilizatè" a swiv lang moun k ap ekspòte a. Li dezaktive pa defo.
disable-activities-description: Lè li aktive, antre fil aktivite yo pa janm anrejistre epi yo pa janm parèt okenn kote (ba lateral tablo ak onglè aktivite kat). Okenn istorik sou kiyès ki te fè kisa pa konsève. Li dezaktive pa defo.
disable-notifications-description: Lè li aktive, WeKan pa janm voye notifikasyon siveyans (nan aplikasyon, imèl oswa lòt sèvis) pou okenn aktivite. Aktivite yo ka toujou anrejistre (sof si yo dezaktive anlè a tou); se sèlman notifikasyon yo ki siprime. Li dezaktive pa defo.
disable-watch-description: Lè li aktive, fonksyon siveyans lan etenn — itilizatè yo pa ka abòne ak tablo, lis oswa kat pou resevwa notifikasyon, epi tout tantativ pou chanje yon nivo siveyans rejte. Li dezaktive pa defo.
backup-description: Fè sovgad Pyès jwenn, Avatar ak/oswa Done (tout koleksyon ki baze sou tèks ki pa pyès jwenn oswa avatar). .zip la pase dirèkteman nan depo chwazi a — san fichye tanporè — kòm backup/YYYY/MM/DD/HH_MM_SS/backup.zip, epi li gen YYYY_MM_DD-HH_MM_SS/attachments, /avatars ak /data. Depo nwaj (S3/MinIO, Azure, GCS) itilize kalifikasyon ki konfigire nan onglè depo yo.
backup-scope-description: Tout enstans lan, oswa yon Òganizasyon. Sovgad yon Òganizasyon gen tablo li yo ak tout bagay sou yo, tankou pyès jwenn tablo sa yo — men li pa gen kont itilizatè ni paramèt enstans, paske chak Òganizasyon pataje yo. Restorasyon sovgad yon Òganizasyon ekri sèlman nan tablo Òganizasyon sa a posede.
theme-override-all-tenants: Ranplasman ki aplike pou tout lokatè
continuous-backup-description: Anrejistre chak chanjman nan baz done a, fichye atache yo, avatar yo ak jounal yo nan yon repètwa nan kèk segonn, pou done yo ka retounen nan eta yo te ye nenpòt ki lè. Li mache ansanm ak sovgad pwograme a, ki kreye achiv konplè.
continuous-backup-enabled: Fè sovgad kontinyèl sou sèvè sa a
continuous-backup-target: Repètwa destinasyon (chemen absoli sou yon lòt disk, yon resous pataje sou rezo a oswa yon espas depo ki monte ak rclone)
continuous-backup-engine-sqlite: Paj SQLite (paj ki chanje nan chak entèval)
continuous-backup-engine-none: Okenn motè baz done pa ka mache sou sèvè sa a
continuous-backup-base-every: Entèval pou kreye yon nouvo kopi debaz (èdtan)
continuous-backup-key-file: Fichye kle chifreman an (chemen absoli, deyò dosye destinasyon an; 64 karaktè ekzadesimal oswa yon fraz sekrè ki gen omwen 16 karaktè). Kenbe yon kopi: san li, ou pa ka retabli sovgad la.
continuous-backup-fetched: Fichye yo rekipere nan nwaj la
continuous-backup-restore-to: Retabli nan eta nan (dat ak lè)
continuous-backup-restore-sqlite: Fichye baz done SQLite (kreye bò kote sovgad la, li pa janm ekri sou fichye k ap itilize a)
continuous-backup-apply-on-restart: Mete bazdone SQLite ki rekonstwi a an sèvis nan pwochen rekòmansman an (bazdone li ranplase a ap konsève)
continuous-backup-restore-confirm: Retabli jenerasyon ou chwazi a nan eta li te ye nan moman ou chwazi a? Sovgad kontinyèl la ap kanpe tanporèman pandan retablisman an.
backup-restore-select-first: Chwazi yon sovgad nan lis la an premye.
backup-restore-confirm: Retabli sovgad ki chwazi a? Pyès jwenn/avatar yo ekri nan sistèm fichye a epi done yo nan bazdone a selon mòd chwazi a.
gcs-key-filename-description: Opsyonèl: chemen yon fichye kle JSON kont sèvis sou sèvè a.
gcs-credentials-description: Opsyonèl: kole kle JSON kont sèvis la. Kite vid pou itilize fichye kle a oswa kalifikasyon pa defo yo.
gcs-permissions-note: Bay kont sèvis WeKan nan aksè lekti/ekriti nan bucket la: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → bucket ou → Permissions → Grant access. Nan "New principals", kole imèl kont sèvis la — valè "client_email" ki nan kle JSON ou — apre sa chwazi wòl "Storage Object Admin" epi anrejistre.
cloud-secret-keep-blank: Kite vid pou konsève valè aktyèl la.
azure-account-name-description: Non kont Azure Storage ou a.
azure-container-description: Resipyan blob kote fichye yo pral estoke.
gcs-project-id-description: ID pwojè Google Cloud ou a.
gcs-bucket-description: Non bucket Cloud Storage kote fichye yo pral estoke.
s3-endpoint-menu-path: AWS: kite vid (li itilize pwen aksè rejyon an). Konpatib ak S3: URL Endpoint ki nan konsole MinIO / Cloudflare R2 / Backblaze B2 / Wasabi / DigitalOcean Spaces ou.
s3-region-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → bucket ou → Properties → AWS Region.
s3-bucket-menu-path: AWS Console → S3 → Buckets → non bucket ou (oswa Create bucket → Bucket name).
s3-access-key-menu-path: AWS Console → IAM → Users → itilizatè ou → Security credentials → Access keys → Create access key → chwazi ka itilizasyon 'Application running outside AWS' → Create access key. Li parèt kòm 'Access key ID'.
s3-secret-key-menu-path: Menm ekran ak Access key ID a; 'Secret access key' parèt yon sèl fwa lè kle a kreye — kopye li lè sa a (oswa Download .csv).
azure-account-name-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → kont ou → non ki parèt anlè a (tou anba Security + networking → Access keys → Storage account name).
azure-account-key-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → kont ou → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Show → Key.
azure-connection-string-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → kont ou → Security + networking → Access keys → key1 → Connection string → Show.
azure-container-menu-path: Azure Portal → Storage accounts → kont ou → Data storage → Containers → resipyan ou (oswa + Container pou kreye youn).
gcs-project-id-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → selektè pwojè anlè a → ID pwojè ou (Cloud overview → Dashboard → Project info → Project ID).
gcs-bucket-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → Cloud Storage → Buckets → non bucket ou (oswa Create pou fè youn).
gcs-key-filename-menu-path: Chemen sou sèvè WeKan nan pou fichye kle JSON kont sèvis ki telechaje a (kreye anba a). Itilize sa OSWA kole JSON nan chan anba a.
gcs-credentials-menu-path: Google Cloud Console → IAM & Admin → Service accounts → kont sèvis ou → Keys → Add key → Create new key → JSON → Create (li telechaje fichye a). Kole kontni li isit la, oswa anrejistre fichye a epi defini chemen li anlè a.

comprehensive-board-migration-descriptio: Fè verifikasyon ak reparasyon konplè pou entegrite done tablo a, tankou lòd lis yo, pozisyon kat yo ak estrikti kouloir yo.
delete-duplicate-empty-lists-migration-d: Efase lis vid ki double yo san danje. Li retire sèlman lis ki pa gen kat EPI ki gen yon lòt lis avèk menm tit la ki gen kat.
restore-lost-cards-migration-description: Jwenn epi retabli kat ak lis ki manke swimlaneId oswa listId. Li kreye yon kouloir 'Kat pèdi' pou fè tout eleman pèdi yo vizib ankò.
restore-all-archived-migration-descripti: Retabli tout kouloir, lis ak kat ki achive. Li korije otomatikman nenpòt swimlaneId oswa listId ki manke pou fè eleman yo vizib.
fix-missing-lists-migration-description: Detekte epi repare lis ki manke oswa ki domaje nan estrikti tablo a.
fix-avatar-urls-migration-description: Mete URL avatar manm tablo yo ajou pou itilize bon sistèm depo a epi korije referans avatar ki kase.
fix-all-file-urls-migration-description: Mete tout URL pyès jwenn fichye sou tablo sa a ajou pou itilize bon sistèm depo a epi korije referans fichye ki kase.
migrations-admin-only: Se sèlman administratè tablo ki ka egzekite migrasyon
migrations-description: Egzekite verifikasyon ak reparasyon entegrite done pou tablo sa a. Chak migrasyon ka egzekite apa.
run-comprehensive-migration-confirm: Sa pral fè yon migrasyon konplè pou verifye ak korije entegrite done tablo a. Sa ka pran kèk moman. Kontinye?

stuck-sync-operation-heading: List Sync operations that cannot be replayed
stuck-sync-operation-description: Each of these saved List Sync operations stopped part way and can no longer be finished, because its list was removed, recreated or reconfigured, or the user who started it lost write access. While one is pending, that list cannot Sync. Discard it to let the list Sync again: changes already applied stay, the remaining saved changes are never written, and the next Sync compares the list with its source again.
stuck-sync-operation-reason-scope-change: The list was removed, recreated or its Sync settings changed
stuck-sync-operation-reason-access-denie: The user who started it no longer has write access to the whole list
stuck-sync-operation-reason-trigger-unkn: Saved by an earlier WeKan version without what started it
stuck-sync-operation-reason-intent-missi: The record of who started it is missing
stuck-sync-operation-replayable-now: It can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-discard-confirm: Discard this saved List Sync operation? Changes it already applied stay; the rest are never written. The list can then Sync again.
stuck-sync-operation-empty: No List Sync operations are waiting for review.
stuck-sync-operation-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Discard some and refresh to see more.
stuck-sync-operation-unavailable: Could not load the List Sync operations. Refresh to try again.
stuck-sync-operation-missing: This operation is no longer pending.
stuck-sync-operation-not-stuck: This operation has not been found stuck, so it cannot be discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-replayable: This operation can be replayed again now and will finish by itself, so it was not discarded.
stuck-sync-operation-busy: This list is syncing right now. Try again in a moment.
stuck-sync-operation-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
interrupted-import-heading: Board imports that stopped before finishing
interrupted-import-description: Each of these board imports stopped part way - the server restarted, or the import failed - and left a partial board. An import cannot be continued, because its source file is not kept. Keep the board as it is, or discard it and import the file again. Discarding removes the board this import created and everything on it, including anything added to it since.
interrupted-import-state-discarding: Being discarded; discard again to finish
interrupted-import-scrum: Its Scrum stage has its own checkpoint (__state__, __next__ of __total__ steps). If you keep the board, finish or discard it from the board's Scrum import recovery.
interrupted-import-counts: __swimlanes__ swimlanes, __lists__ lists, __cards__ cards, __checklists__ checklists, __comments__ comments, __attachments__ attachments
interrupted-import-keep-confirm: Keep this partial board as it is? Nothing is removed, and the import is no longer listed here.
interrupted-import-discard-confirm: Discard this import? The board it created and everything on it are removed permanently.
interrupted-import-empty: No interrupted board imports are waiting for review.
interrupted-import-truncated: Only the oldest 50 are shown. Keep or discard some and refresh to see more.
interrupted-import-unavailable: Could not load the interrupted board imports. Refresh to try again.
interrupted-import-missing: This import is no longer recorded.
interrupted-import-not-interrupted: This import is not waiting for a decision any more.
interrupted-import-foreign-board: The board with this id was not created by this import, so it was not touched.
interrupted-import-scrum-busy: Its Scrum stage is still being written or recovered. Try again in a few minutes.
interrupted-import-failed: Could not complete this action. Refresh and try again.
